title: Global Vegetation (NDVI) — January 2020 vs January 2023

source.attribution: MODIS Terra MOD13C2 Version 6.1 monthly NDVI composite. Data courtesy of the NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC (LP DAAC) at the USGS Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center.
source.disclaimer: NDVI is a dimensionless physical index, not a direct measurement of biomass or forest cover. January composites represent monthly maximum-value composites and may be affected by snow, cloud, or atmospheric conditions.

description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) derived from MODIS Terra MOD13C2 Version 6.1 monthly composites. NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red). Values represent the maximum-value composite for January of each year. Ocean, water bodies, and persistently clouded areas are null. Shared normalization: source_min=-0.2, source_max=1.0.

channels.name: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
channels.description: Dimensionless vegetation index. 0 = bare soil or water (NDVI ≈ -0.2). 1 = dense, healthy vegetation (NDVI ≈ 1.0).

legend.pitch: Higher pitch indicates higher NDVI (denser vegetation). Low pitch indicates sparse or absent vegetation.
legend.stereo: Horizontal grid position controls stereo panning (west = left, east = right).
legend.silence: Silent cells are ocean, water bodies, or areas with persistent cloud cover.
